tools.name: geo_describe_service
tools.description: Read ScopeAI's current GEO targets, availability, limitations and connection details. Free; no account, model call or website fetch. Use before proposing a paid observation.

tools.name: geo_match_request
tools.description: Check whether a GEO intent, exact target, measurement surface, language, market and deliverables are supported. Free and deterministic; never starts a project or paid task. Consumer App/browser measurements cannot be substituted with model API results.

tools.name: geo_prepare_optimization
tools.description: Use when the customer says start GEO optimization. Free, anonymous preparation: collect brand and public HTTPS website, then return a structured task handoff for the customer's Codex/CMS maintainer, factual evidence requirements, preview/publication gates and same-condition retest. Missing brand/web

tools.name: geo_list_targets
tools.description: Read current GEO target availability and pricing using the configured API Key. Does not start a model call or charge the wallet. Check enabled and scope before quoting.

tools.name: geo_create_project
tools.description: Create a private brand project from customer-approved information. Requires API Key and geo:write permission. Changes the account workspace but does not start paid observation or publish content.

tools.name: geo_quote_observation
tools.description: Create an expiring quote for a customer-owned project and explicit target/questions/repeats. Requires geo:write. Does not start sampling or debit the wallet. Show the quoted amount, scope and expiry before acceptance.

tools.name: geo_accept_observation
tools.description: Starts a PAID asynchronous observation and reserves funds. Use only after the customer approved this quote and maximum charge. Requires API Key, geo:run grant, approved=true, max_charge_cents and a stable idempotency_key. Retry with the same key; never silently switch targets, increase the budget or

tools.name: geo_get_observation
tools.description: Read an owned observation task and its financial state; does not start or retry sampling. Requires API Key. Use the original task ID after timeout before considering any new task.

tools.name: geo_get_answers
tools.description: Read a page of actual answer units from an owned observation. Preserve failed/missing units and the API measurement scope; do not invent answers or interpret absence as a negative mention. Requires API Key; no new sampling.

tools.name: geo_get_sources
tools.description: Read the returned source/citation records of an owned observation. A URL alone does not prove support for a claim. Requires API Key; no new sampling or website fetch.

tools.name: geo_cancel_observation
tools.description: Cancel a customer-requested owned observation and return its fee state. Requires API Key; already executed units may remain billable under the accepted quote. Does not create another task.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "geo_prepare_optimization" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: geo_get_sources · Private data: geo_list_targets, geo_create_project, geo_quote_observation, geo_accept_observation, geo_get_observation, geo_get_answers, geo_get_sources, geo_cancel_observation · Public sink: geo_prepare_optimization, geo_create_project · Destructive: geo_accept_observation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: geo_get_sources · Private data: geo_list_targets, geo_create_project, geo_quote_observation, geo_accept_observation, geo_get_observation, geo_get_answers, geo_get_sources, geo_cancel_observation · Public sink: geo_prepare_optimization, geo_create_project · Destructive: geo_accept_observation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
